t.E142.agn: In 2010 EFSA maintained the ADI for green S at 5 mg/kg body weight. In the refined estimate, intakes remained below this limit.
t.E142.body: In rats, very little of the orally administered green S passed into urine and most was excreted in faeces. In pigs and calves no absorption was seen and all of it was excreted in faeces.
t.E142.prod: A dye produced by chemical synthesis.
t.E142.regx.0: ADI 5 mg/kg maintained; below the limit in the refined estimate.
t.E142.summary: A synthetic, green dye. It is used in canned peas, confectionery and sauces.
